text.text: Vidya Events (Swapnil) did an absolutely mind-blowing decoration! 💙✨ The blue & silver theme backdrop, balloon arch, disco balls, and light-up name letters looked stunning. It created a truly royal setup for the birthday celebration. All the guests loved the decoration and the photos came out amazing. Service was perfectly on time, planning was neat, and professionalism was top-notch. Highly recommend Vidya Events for any celebration! 👌🎉

The decoration was absolutely stunning! ✈️🌍 The travel theme with passport, suitcases, and Eiffel Tower looked so creative and unique. The balloon arrangement was beautiful and made the whole backdrop perfect for photos. All the guests loved it, and it truly made the event memorable!

Thank you so much Swapnil Mhatre

It was the best experience with Vidya Events very affordable, and even on short notice, they work with great dedication and professionalism. Their balloon decoration added a vibrant touch to the event. The colors, designs, and creative arrangements were beautifully done, making the venue look elegant.
Do choose them for any type of events for your loved ones.

We booked them for my child’s first birthday with a Jake and the Never Land Pirates theme, and everything was perfect! The decor, planning, and execution were amazing. Highly recommend their services for any special occasion!

HIGHLYY RECOMMEND!! We had an amazing experience with the décor setup! The decoration was beautifully done with vibrant balloon arrangements, adorable baby cut-outs, a lovely floral swing, and a perfect blend of colors for the baby shower theme. The backdrop with “Baby Shower” neon light added a modern and elegant touch, while the moon prop, teddy, and flowers made the entire stage look warm and welcoming.
